title: Original semaphore bounded reservation and unresolved acquisition state
oracle: Actual availablePermits counter observations, immediate original permit.release once, retained actual acquire-return objects distinguished from a released marker, and bounded pending acquire snapshots. Independent external held-count bookkeeping covers integer capacities1..16; fixed literal counter tables characterize fractional/coercive inputs. No later-release or queue lifecycle helper is fabricated.

trials.execution: Executed partial reservation subset against actual archived sources at 1051710191 and 1051908825 through the local core Subject: 33 cases, 435 probes per revision; 34 tests passed. Explicit diagnostic process mode reports isolated:false; no container or production scheduling proof.
trials.knownGateScope: No recognized reads in the seven present full dependency modules; missing original cr:6640 leaves its gate/domain/bootstrap behavior unknown. One known empty fixture context is not complete original-provider coverage.
trials.reservationScope: First acquire releases its own actual permit immediately and retains that released object; later actual acquired objects remain held, differ from the marker, and pair with observed counter decrements. This does not prove their whole permit interface or later invocation.
trials.pendingScope: Zero/negative/NaN/null/falsy/nonnumeric capacity cases start two real acquisitions and inspect bounded unresolved state. No indefinite await, manufactured release or cancellation.
trials.blocked: Release of held permits after intervening probes, queued waiter fulfillment/FIFO, double-release error, cancellation, fairness, permit branding and full lifecycle.
trials.domains: Capacities/coercion inputs and histories are unbounded. Generated bounded integers and selected literal capacities are characterization only; no enum sampling/exhaustiveness claim.

exclusions: Actual source Semaphore constructor, availablePermits and acquire only, plus one immediate original returned release per reservation case. No internal/mangled helper, synthetic permit/factory/callback, host function/object/Promise injection or generic property selector is used.

All later held-permit release, queued waiter fulfillment/FIFO, double-release, cancellation, fairness, interface/branding, concurrency/task interleavings and full semaphore lifecycle remain blocked by current observation controls, not implied by counter/identity assertions.

References and pending operations remain case-wide incompatible. Bounded pending cases contain no retained refs and are inspected without awaiting forever. Held reservation cases do not queue another waiter after capacity is consumed.
Each case constructs a fresh actual instance. This is fresh-instance isolation, not a reset/disposal/restart or memory/queue cleanup proof.

Explicit cr:6640=null selects the real Promise module native realm fallback. The missing original conditional implementation, original provider domains/bootstrap and full configuration acceptance remain unknown.

Capacity values are source-unvalidated/coercive. Fractional negative remaining counts are selected original behavior observations, not a positive-integer API guarantee. Arbitrary inputs, Infinity, signed-zero transport distinctions and operation histories are not exhaustive.
No container production isolation, suite scheduling, browser/native/account/network/storage/crypto provider, calling/WASM or named-library implementation acceptance is established.
